blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker and Leyte Representative is now at the New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas on Monday night. Romualdez came from the Philippine General Hospital (PGH) where he was confined over the weekend. Earlier, there were reports that Romualdez will arrive at Payatas jail no later than 6 p.m. and the reason for apparent delay was not immediately clear. On Monday noon, the Sandiganbayan Third Division ordered to transfer the custody of Romualdez to the jail facility from PGH.
